create.title: New project
create.description: Services in one project share a private network and a set of variables.
create.name: Project name
create.invalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting and ending with a letter or digit.

page.emptyTitle: No services in this project yet
page.emptyDescription: Add a service to run a container image, then deploy it from its own page.
page.noMatch: Nothing is in this state right now.

settings.pageDescription: What every service of this project shares.

env.title: Shared variables
env.description: Given to every service here, ahead of its own variables. A running service keeps its old values until its next deploy.
env.savedHint: They reach a service at its next deploy.
env.invalidLine: Line {{line}} needs to look like NAME=value.

schema.title: Portable description
schema.description: This project as JSON, for keeping or moving it elsewhere. Passwords are never included.

access.title: Access
access.description: Who reaches this project, and as what. Viewers see states and inventory; operators can also configure and deploy. Administrators reach every project.
access.everyProject: {{role}} in every project, set on the Users page
access.ownRole: Its own role in this project
access.accountHint: Members who don't reach this project yet. Someone new is invited from Settings → Users.
access.roleHint: Viewers see states and inventory. Operators can also configure and deploy.
access.nobodyToAdd: Every member already reaches this project. Someone new is invited from Settings → Users.
access.lowerDescription: It takes effect at once: their sessions end and their API keys are revoked, as with any loss of rights.

danger.title: Destroy this project
danger.description: Only an empty project can be destroyed, so its services go first, one at a time.
danger.warning_one: Delete the service in this project first.
danger.warning_other: Delete the {{count}} services in this project first.
danger.removed: Its network and its shared variables.
danger.kept: Volumes kept from services it used to hold, and their backups. Delete kept volumes under Monitor, Storage.
